extracted.name: Cream Cheese Frosting
extracted.description: This easy Cream Cheese Frosting recipe is silky smooth, sweet, and ready to put on cinnamon rolls, carrot cake, and cookies! It takes less than 10 minutes to make!
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese and butter together until smooth, about 2 minutes. Mix in vanilla.
Add powdered sugar, one cup at a time, mixing well. For best results, beat frosting for several minutes, to make it extra smooth and fluffy/creamy in texture.
Use to frost cakes, cupcakes, cinnamon rolls, cookies and cookie bars.
